title: Orders on the Batch and Late-Delivery Dispute Credits — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Rule.** In a late-delivery dispute on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the store-wait credit and the detour credit are added, and that sum is then adjusted by the orders the disputed violation's batch carried, as the batch record in Cartwise Shopper Batches shows: on a batch of three or more orders it is doubled; on a batch of two orders it is increased by half of itself, the half rounded up to a whole point; on a single-order batch it is used as it stands.

## Questions answered (hypothetical sums)

**A Triple Delivery Batch with a store-wait and detour sum of 2 points?** Three orders: doubled to 4 points.

**A Double Delivery Batch with a sum of 1 point?** Half of 1 is 0.5, rounded up to 1; 1 plus 1 gives 2 points.

**A Double Delivery Batch with a sum of 3 points?** Half of 3 is 1.5, rounded up to 2; 3 plus 2 gives 5 points.

**A Single Delivery Batch with a sum of 3 points?** Used as it stands: 3 points.

| Sum | Three or more orders | Two orders | One order |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| 2 | 4 | 3 | 2 |
| 4 | 8 | 6 | 4 |
